plan: A mobile marksman who swings around walls and revives his allies by killing their killer.
aSurveiller: His E (Heroic Swing). He swings around a wall while shooting at you: huge damage, and he also uses it to engage or to escape.
contrer: During his R, hide behind an ally, a minion, a jungle monster or a turret: the bullets hit the first target.
Don't kill an ally and then stay near him: if he kills you, the ally comes back to life.
Slow him before he grabs a wall (E).
forces: Very mobile thanks to his grappling hook (E).
Revives allies by killing their killer.
faiblesses: Less strong in the late game.

sorts.P: Every 3 hits, bonus damage and a shield.
sorts.Q: Boomerang that hits on the way out and back.
sorts.W: Marks his allies' killers; he becomes camouflaged.
sorts.E: Swings around a wall while shooting.
sorts.R: Bullet barrage, stronger on a wounded target.

momentFort: Very strong in lane from the start: he pokes and dominates his opponent. Dangerous for finishing off from level 6.
